xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DisclosureOfNotesOnSegmentsEx: The Group’s operating segments are established on the basis of those components of the group that are evaluated regularly by the Group as, in deciding how to allocate resources and in assessing performance (referred to in IND AS 108 - ‘Operating Segments’). These have been identified taking into account nature of activity, risks and returns. The Company has two principal operating segments; viz. Jewellery Manufacturing and Investments.
